title: Shapes and turns table
subject: Computing
unit: Spring 1: Repetition in shapes and data logging
source: Seeded from computing/y4 lesson 6 (Shapes and turns table (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 6: Drawing shapes with the repeat block. To understand how a repeat block and the pen draw regular shapes on screen

questions.q: Build the square script and run it.
questions.model: Teacher builds it block by block, predicting 'a square' before the green flag.

questions.q: Change it to draw a triangle.
What turn do you need for a pentagon (5 sides)?
Core: Draw a hexagon with a repeat block.
questions.model: Teacher works out 360 / 6 = 60 aloud, then builds and runs it.

questions.q: Extend: Draw an octagon (8 sides). Write the turn sum first.
Stretch: Try 'repeat 36 (move 10, turn 10)'. What shape appears and why?
questions.a: Almost a circle: 36 x 10 = 360, with many tiny sides.

questions.q: For a square the sprite turns... A) 45 B) 90 C) 120
Explain how to find the turn for any regular shape.
questions.a: Divide 360 by the number of sides.
